title: No media ingest / asset store: large media cannot be fed (not tokenized by bytes); no per-asset ids/metadata

rcca.root_cause: No ingest/normalize/split layer and no asset store existed; intake stored images verbatim only, audio/video were untyped binary, and llm_client had no producer for media parts.
rcca.corrective: core/asset_store.py (AS-* assets, sha256 dedupe, metadata probe, guarded tiling/segmentation/frame-sampling, to_media bridge); intake audio/video typing; wired at run-start preflight + CLI media; stores registered.
rcca.preventive: Every segmenter is lib-guarded and degrades (degraded+reason) instead of raising; assets are content-addressed and deduped; single writer per store.
